pages.title: Our Story & Team
pages.goal: Build genuine emotional connection by telling the Sproutly origin story, introducing the people behind the brand, and communicating the values that drive every design decision — turning a clothing label into a brand parents feel proud to support.

sections.intent: Set the editorial tone for a page that is about people and purpose, not product — signalling to the visitor that this is where the brand's heart lives.
sections.headline: We Started Sproutly Because Our Kids Kept Outgrowing Everything — Including Boring Clothes.
sections.subheadline: A brand born on a rainy Tuesday, in a kitchen, by two parents who'd had enough.

sections.intent: Tell the founding story with warmth and specificity — a deliberate, unhurried narrative that makes the brand feel human, relatable, and rooted in real parenting experience.
sections.headline: From a Kitchen Table to 50,000 Families
sections.body: In 2018, designers and parents Anya and Tom Beckett were standing in a changing room watching their daughter refuse to wear yet another scratchy, grey, shapeless outfit. They drove home, sketched their first design on the back of a school letter, and called it Sproutly. The idea was simple: make clothes that kids choose to wear, that survive a full season of actual childhood, and that parents don't feel guilty buying. Six years later, Sproutly dresses children in 14 countries — and Anya's daughter still has opinions about what she wears.

asset_ideas.subject: A warm, simple illustration of two adults sketching a children's outfit at a kitchen table, surrounded by fabric swatches, cups of tea, and a child's drawing on the fridge
asset_ideas.purpose: Humanises the brand origin story and makes the founding moment feel personal and real

sections.intent: Articulate the brand values as clear, memorable principles — giving parents a framework for understanding why Sproutly makes every decision it does.
sections.headline: Three Things We'll Never Compromise On

items.title: Joy in Every Stitch
items.description: If a child wouldn't choose it themselves, we don't make it. Design starts with what kids love, then we make it parent-approved.

items.title: Honest Materials
items.description: No greenwashing. Every fabric claim is certified, every supply chain is audited, and we publish our full supplier list online.

items.title: Clothes That Last
items.description: We design for three seasons, not one. Durability is a feature, not a bonus — because landfill isn't an option.

sections.subheadline: Everything parents ask us, answered honestly.

sections.intent: Address sizing and fit questions — the number one barrier to buying kids' clothing online — with clear, reassuring guidance that reduces return rates and builds confidence.
sections.headline: Will It Actually Fit My Child?

items.title: How does Sproutly sizing work?
items.description: Our sizes are based on height in centimetres rather than age, because children grow at very different rates. Each product page includes a full measurement guide.

items.title: Do your clothes run large or small?
items.description: Sproutly clothes are cut with a generous, active fit. If your child is between sizes, we recommend sizing up — especially in outerwear.

items.title: What if it doesn't fit?
items.description: No problem. We offer free exchanges on all full-price items within 60 days of purchase. Just use the returns portal in your account.

items.title: Do you have a size guide?
items.description: Yes — every product page links to our full size guide with chest, waist, and height measurements for every size we make.

asset_ideas.subject: A clean, friendly size guide chart showing Sproutly size tiers mapped to height ranges and approximate age ranges, with a simple illustrated child silhouette for scale
asset_ideas.purpose: Visual sizing reference that reduces purchase anxiety and return rates

sections.intent: Reassure parents about fabric safety, washing care, and durability — the second most common concern for parents buying kids' clothes online.
sections.headline: What Are Sproutly Clothes Made Of?

items.title: Are Sproutly fabrics safe for sensitive skin?
items.description: Yes. Every fabric we use is OEKO-TEX Standard 100 certified, meaning it's been tested and proven free from over 100 harmful substances.

items.title: Do you use organic cotton?
items.description: Where possible, yes. Our basics range — tees, pyjamas, and underlayers — is made from GOTS-certified organic cotton. Outerwear uses recycled synthetic fibres.

items.title: How should I wash Sproutly clothes?
items.description: Most items are machine washable at 30°C. Detailed care instructions are printed on every label and available on each product page.

items.title: Will the colours fade after washing?
items.description: We use low-impact, colour-fast dyes and test every print to withstand at least 100 washes. We're proud to say most parents report colours still looking great after a full season.

sections.intent: Remove delivery and returns friction — practical questions that, if left unanswered, cause cart abandonment at the final step.
sections.headline: When Will It Arrive — and What If I Need to Send It Back?

items.title: How long does delivery take?
items.description: Standard UK delivery takes 3–5 working days. Express next-day delivery is available for orders placed before 1pm Monday–Friday.

items.title: Do you ship internationally?
items.description: Yes — we ship to 30+ countries. International delivery times and costs are calculated at checkout based on your location.

items.title: What is your returns policy?
items.description: We accept returns on unworn, unwashed items with tags attached within 60 days of purchase. Full-price items qualify for free returns via our online portal.

items.title: How long does a refund take?
items.description: Once we receive your return, refunds are processed within 5 working days back to your original payment method.

sections.intent: Answer sustainability questions honestly — parents who care about ethics need specific, verifiable answers, not vague promises.
sections.headline: How Sustainable Is Sproutly, Really?

items.title: Are you a sustainable brand?
items.description: We're honest about this: we're on a journey, not at the destination. We publish an annual impact report detailing exactly where we are and where we're heading.

items.title: Where are your clothes made?
items.description: Our garments are made in Portugal and Turkey in factories we visit annually. Full supplier details are published on our website.

items.title: Do you use recycled packaging?
items.description: Yes — all Sproutly packaging is made from 100% recycled materials and is itself fully recyclable. We removed all single-use plastic from our packaging in 2021.

items.title: What happens to clothes that don't sell?
items.description: Unsold stock is donated to children's charities in the UK. We have never sent deadstock to landfill.
